_comment: UTC daily snapshots. Unsupported historical commentary is preserved in audit/original-editorial.json, not presented as measured fact.

snapshots.label: Genesis block
snapshots.context: Block 0 was mined on this UTC date.
selectionReasons: Missing protocol or approval anchor; verify against primary source

snapshots.label: Early mining
snapshots.context: Early mining after the genesis block.

snapshots.label: First peer-to-peer transaction
snapshots.context: The first recorded Bitcoin transfer between Satoshi Nakamoto and Hal Finney is included in block 170.

snapshots.label: Fed expands quantitative easing
snapshots.context: The Federal Reserve expands asset purchases and announces purchases of longer-term Treasury securities.

snapshots.label: Iran presidential election
snapshots.context: Iran holds its disputed presidential election; large protests follow.

snapshots.label: New Liberty Standard exchange rate
snapshots.context: An early published Bitcoin-to-dollar exchange-rate quotation.

snapshots.label: First difficulty increase
snapshots.context: Block 32,256 begins the first difficulty period above difficulty 1.

snapshots.label: Bitcoin Market development
snapshots.context: An early development checkpoint for Bitcoin Market; trading opened later, in March.

snapshots.label: US Flash Crash
snapshots.context: US markets experience the Flash Crash.

snapshots.label: Bitcoin Pizza Day
snapshots.context: Laszlo Hanyecz reports completing a pizza purchase for 10,000 BTC.

snapshots.label: Bitcoin reaches Slashdot
snapshots.context: Slashdot publishes its Bitcoin version 0.3 story.

snapshots.label: Value-overflow incident
snapshots.context: Developers respond to the value-overflow bug. This geometry shows the surviving canonical chain, not the invalid branch.

snapshots.label: Tunisian uprising begins
snapshots.context: Protests beginning in Tunisia become a starting point of the Arab Spring.

snapshots.label: Dollar parity
snapshots.context: Bitcoin reaches dollar parity in the daily reference-price series.

snapshots.label: Tohoku earthquake and Fukushima
snapshots.context: An earthquake and tsunami strike Japan, triggering the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear accident.

snapshots.label: TIME covers Bitcoin
snapshots.context: TIME’s Techland article brings Bitcoin to a broader audience.

snapshots.label: Mt. Gox security breach
snapshots.context: A security incident disrupts trading at the early Bitcoin exchange.

snapshots.label: US credit rating downgrade
snapshots.context: Standard & Poor’s lowers the United States’ long-term sovereign rating from AAA to AA+.

snapshots.label: Gold's 2011 record
snapshots.context: Gold reaches its 2011 London PM fixing record during the sovereign-debt crisis.

snapshots.label: 2011 bear-market trough
snapshots.context: A low-price checkpoint near the end of Bitcoin’s first major market cycle.

snapshots.label: Linode security breach
snapshots.context: A hosting-account compromise affects several Bitcoin services.

snapshots.label: Draghi: whatever it takes
snapshots.context: ECB President Mario Draghi pledges to do what is necessary within the bank’s mandate to preserve the euro.

snapshots.label: Bitcoin Foundation launches
snapshots.context: Gavin Andresen announces the Bitcoin Foundation.

snapshots.label: Obama reelected
snapshots.context: US presidential election day. Barack Obama wins reelection; vote counting extends beyond this UTC snapshot.

snapshots.label: First halving
snapshots.context: The subsidy became 25 BTC at block 210,000.

snapshots.label: Accidental Bitcoin chain split
snapshots.context: A block-processing incompatibility splits the network. The displayed blocks belong to the surviving canonical chain.

snapshots.label: Cyprus bank bailout agreement
snapshots.context: The Eurogroup announces an agreement concerning Cyprus’s bank restructuring and bailout.

snapshots.label: April 2013 market reversal
snapshots.context: The April 2013 speculative rally reaches its reversal period.

snapshots.label: Snowden surveillance disclosures
snapshots.context: NSA surveillance disclosures bring digital privacy into worldwide debate.

snapshots.label: Silk Road shutdown
snapshots.context: US authorities shut down the Silk Road marketplace.

snapshots.label: Senate virtual-currency hearing
snapshots.context: US Senate subcommittees examine the present and future impact of virtual currency.

snapshots.label: China payment restrictions: aftermath
snapshots.context: A December market checkpoint after China’s initial Bitcoin restrictions, announced earlier that month.

snapshots.label: Mt. Gox crisis
snapshots.context: A checkpoint during the exchange’s closure crisis; its Japanese bankruptcy filing followed on February 28.

snapshots.label: Russia annexes Crimea
snapshots.context: Russia announces the annexation of Crimea, which is internationally contested.

snapshots.label: IRS Bitcoin tax guidance
snapshots.context: The IRS announces its treatment of virtual currency as property for US federal tax purposes.

snapshots.label: First US Marshals Bitcoin auction
snapshots.context: The US Marshals Service holds its first auction of seized Silk Road bitcoins.

snapshots.label: Ebola international emergency
snapshots.context: WHO declares the West African Ebola outbreak a public-health emergency of international concern.

snapshots.label: 2014 autumn selloff
snapshots.context: An autumn checkpoint in the prolonged 2014 Bitcoin drawdown.

snapshots.label: 2015 bear-market trough
snapshots.context: A January checkpoint near the low of the 2014–15 drawdown.

snapshots.label: Swiss franc currency shock
snapshots.context: The Swiss National Bank removes its minimum exchange rate against the euro.

snapshots.label: BIP66 invalid-block alert
snapshots.context: Bitcoin.org warns about invalid blocks during the BIP66 upgrade. This dataset contains canonical blocks.

snapshots.label: China's Black Monday
snapshots.context: Chinese equities fall sharply during a global market selloff.

snapshots.label: The Economist: The trust machine
snapshots.context: The Economist features blockchain in its October 31 issue.

snapshots.label: Paris attacks
snapshots.context: Coordinated terrorist attacks take place in Paris.

snapshots.label: Mike Hearn’s Bitcoin departure
snapshots.context: Mike Hearn publishes his account of leaving the Bitcoin project.

snapshots.label: AlphaGo wins first Lee Sedol game
snapshots.context: AlphaGo plays and wins its first match game against Lee Sedol.

snapshots.label: The DAO attack
snapshots.context: An exploit drains funds from The DAO on Ethereum; this snapshot measures Bitcoin on that date.

snapshots.label: Brexit result
snapshots.context: The UK referendum result confirms a vote to leave the European Union.

snapshots.label: Second halving
snapshots.context: The subsidy became 12.5 BTC at block 420,000.

snapshots.label: Bitfinex security breach
snapshots.context: Bitfinex halts trading after discovering a Bitcoin-wallet security breach.

snapshots.label: US election: Trump wins
snapshots.context: US presidential election day. Donald Trump wins; the result becomes clear on November 9 UTC.

snapshots.label: Winklevoss ETF proposal rejected
snapshots.context: The SEC disapproves the proposed listing of the Winklevoss Bitcoin Trust.

snapshots.label: Japan’s exchange rules take effect
snapshots.context: Japan’s amended Payment Services Act introduces registration for cryptocurrency exchanges.

snapshots.label: WannaCry ransomware outbreak
snapshots.context: The WannaCry ransomware outbreak spreads internationally.

snapshots.label: UASF eve
snapshots.context: The day before BIP148’s August 1 activation date; SegWit lock-in followed on August 9.

snapshots.label: Bitcoin Cash chain split
snapshots.context: Bitcoin Cash separates from Bitcoin. This visualization continues to follow Bitcoin’s chain.

snapshots.label: SegWit locks in
snapshots.context: Block 479,808 begins SegWit’s locked-in period, before activation on August 24.

snapshots.label: SegWit activation
snapshots.context: SegWit activated at block 481,824.
selectionReasons: Missing protocol or approval anchor; verify against primary source

snapshots.label: China bans ICO fundraising
snapshots.context: Chinese authorities announce restrictions on initial coin offerings.

snapshots.label: 2017 bull-market peak
snapshots.context: A checkpoint at the crest of the December 2017 rally.

snapshots.label: December 2017 fee surge
snapshots.context: A high-fee day during the December 2017 activity surge.

snapshots.label: January 2018 selloff
snapshots.context: The January selloff follows the late-2017 speculative peak.

snapshots.label: Coinrail security breach
snapshots.context: Coinrail reports a security breach.

snapshots.label: 2018 bear-market trough
snapshots.context: A December checkpoint near the low of the 2018 drawdown.

snapshots.label: Fed raises rates amid selloff
snapshots.context: The Federal Reserve raises its target range to 2.25–2.50 percent.

snapshots.label: 2019 market recovery
snapshots.context: Bitcoin’s early-2019 recovery following the previous year’s drawdown.

snapshots.label: April 2019 breakout
snapshots.context: A sharp upward move in the daily Bitcoin reference-price series.

snapshots.label: 2019 rally crest
snapshots.context: A late-June checkpoint near the crest of the 2019 rally.

snapshots.label: Google's quantum supremacy paper
snapshots.context: Google publishes a quantum-sampling benchmark result. It is not a demonstration of breaking Bitcoin’s cryptography.

snapshots.label: Xi’s blockchain study session
snapshots.context: China’s leadership discusses blockchain on October 24; the public report follows on October 25.

snapshots.label: WHO declares coronavirus emergency
snapshots.context: WHO declares the novel-coronavirus outbreak a public-health emergency of international concern.

snapshots.label: Before the COVID market crash
snapshots.context: A February market checkpoint before the March pandemic selloff.

snapshots.label: WHO characterizes COVID-19 pandemic
snapshots.context: WHO characterizes COVID-19 as a pandemic.

snapshots.label: COVID market crash
snapshots.context: Bitcoin falls sharply during the global pandemic market crisis.

snapshots.label: Fed emergency rate cut and QE
snapshots.context: The Federal Reserve cuts its target rate to near zero and announces further asset purchases.

snapshots.label: Post-crash mining checkpoint
snapshots.context: A mining-activity comparison day after the March 2020 market crash.

snapshots.label: WTI oil futures turn negative
snapshots.context: The expiring front-month WTI oil futures contract trades below zero.

snapshots.label: Third halving
snapshots.context: The subsidy became 6.25 BTC at block 630,000.

snapshots.label: DeFi summer: Bitcoin checkpoint
snapshots.context: A mid-2020 Bitcoin comparison day during the broader cryptocurrency expansion.

snapshots.label: MicroStrategy adopts Bitcoin reserves
snapshots.context: MicroStrategy announces Bitcoin as its primary treasury reserve asset.

snapshots.label: Square buys Bitcoin
snapshots.context: Square announces its Bitcoin treasury investment. PayPal’s separate announcement came later in October.

snapshots.label: US election: Biden wins
snapshots.context: US presidential election day. Joe Biden ultimately wins; the race is called several days later.

snapshots.label: Bitcoin breaks $20,000
snapshots.context: The daily Bitcoin reference price crosses $20,000.

snapshots.label: Bitcoin’s 12th anniversary
snapshots.context: Twelve years since the genesis block.

snapshots.label: US Capitol attack
snapshots.context: The US Capitol is attacked during certification of the presidential election.

snapshots.label: Tesla discloses Bitcoin purchase
snapshots.context: Tesla discloses a $1.5 billion Bitcoin investment.

snapshots.label: Trillion-dollar valuation
snapshots.context: Bitcoin’s daily reference market capitalization crosses one trillion US dollars.

snapshots.label: Coinbase direct listing
snapshots.context: Coinbase shares begin trading on Nasdaq through a direct listing.

snapshots.label: Tesla suspends Bitcoin payments
snapshots.context: Tesla announces it will stop accepting Bitcoin for vehicle purchases.

snapshots.label: China mining crackdown: aftermath
snapshots.context: A late-June checkpoint after China’s May crackdown announcement and June provincial restrictions.

snapshots.label: El Salvador adopts Bitcoin
snapshots.context: El Salvador’s Bitcoin legal-tender framework takes effect.

snapshots.label: Evergrande debt crisis selloff
snapshots.context: Global equities sell off amid concern about Evergrande’s debt problems.

snapshots.label: China's cryptocurrency prohibition
snapshots.context: China publishes its interagency notice restricting cryptocurrency-related business activities.

snapshots.label: 2021 bull-market peak
snapshots.context: A November checkpoint at the crest of the 2021 Bitcoin rally.

snapshots.label: Taproot activation
snapshots.context: Taproot activated at block 709,632.
selectionReasons: Missing protocol or approval anchor; verify against primary source

snapshots.label: December 2021 selloff
snapshots.context: Bitcoin’s daily price falls during the December market selloff.

snapshots.label: Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine
snapshots.context: Russia launches its full-scale invasion of Ukraine, escalating the conflict that began in 2014.

snapshots.label: Terra crisis: market selloff
snapshots.context: A Bitcoin market checkpoint during the TerraUSD depegging crisis.

snapshots.label: Celsius freezes withdrawals
snapshots.context: Celsius’s June 12 US-evening announcement falls on June 13 UTC.

snapshots.label: Fed raises rates by 75 basis points
snapshots.context: The Federal Reserve raises its target range by 75 basis points.

snapshots.label: Celsius files for bankruptcy
snapshots.context: Celsius files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection.

snapshots.label: Ethereum’s Merge
snapshots.context: Ethereum switches from proof of work to proof of stake; this snapshot still measures Bitcoin.

snapshots.label: FTX files for bankruptcy
snapshots.context: FTX and affiliated companies file for Chapter 11 protection.

snapshots.label: ChatGPT launches
snapshots.context: OpenAI releases ChatGPT as a public research preview.

snapshots.label: 2022 bear-market year-end
snapshots.context: A year-end checkpoint after the 2022 cryptocurrency drawdown.

snapshots.label: January 2023 recovery
snapshots.context: The daily Bitcoin price rebounds during the January recovery.

snapshots.label: Turkey and Syria earthquakes
snapshots.context: Major earthquakes strike southern Turkey and northern Syria.

snapshots.label: Silicon Valley Bank closes
snapshots.context: Regulators close Silicon Valley Bank and appoint the FDIC as receiver.

snapshots.label: GPT-4 launches
snapshots.context: OpenAI announces GPT-4.

snapshots.label: Nvidia's AI boom rally
snapshots.context: The trading day after Nvidia’s results and outlook emphasize rapidly growing generative-AI demand.

snapshots.label: BlackRock files for a Bitcoin trust
snapshots.context: The iShares Bitcoin Trust’s initial S-1 registration is filed with the SEC.

snapshots.label: Hamas attack on Israel
snapshots.context: Hamas and other Palestinian armed groups attack southern Israel, killing civilians and taking hostages.

snapshots.label: Spot ETF anticipation rally
snapshots.context: An October rally checkpoint before the January 2024 spot ETF decision.

snapshots.label: December 2023 fee surge
snapshots.context: A high-fee day during the December 2023 activity surge.

snapshots.label: Awaiting the spot ETF decision
snapshots.context: A late-December checkpoint before the SEC’s January 10 decision.

snapshots.label: US spot Bitcoin ETF approval
snapshots.context: The SEC approved listing and trading of spot Bitcoin ETP shares.
selectionReasons: Missing protocol or approval anchor; verify against primary source

snapshots.label: US spot Bitcoin ETF trading begins
snapshots.context: Trading began the day after SEC approval.

snapshots.label: Post-ETF market expansion
snapshots.context: A February market checkpoint after US spot Bitcoin ETF trading began.

snapshots.label: March 2024 rally crest
snapshots.context: A March checkpoint during Bitcoin’s advance beyond the 2021 market highs.

snapshots.label: Iran attacks Israel directly
snapshots.context: Iran launches a large direct attack on Israel.

snapshots.label: Fourth halving
snapshots.context: The subsidy became 3.125 BTC at block 840,000 (UTC date).

snapshots.label: May 2024 market rally
snapshots.context: A Bitcoin market checkpoint during the May 2024 rally.

snapshots.label: German Bitcoin sale period
snapshots.context: A checkpoint during the German authorities’ sale period, June 19–July 12.

snapshots.label: Mt. Gox repayments begin
snapshots.context: The rehabilitation trustee begins Bitcoin and Bitcoin Cash repayments to some creditors.

snapshots.label: Global market selloff
snapshots.context: Bitcoin falls alongside a broad August selloff in global risk assets.

snapshots.label: Gold crosses $2,500
snapshots.context: Gold trades above US$2,500 per troy ounce.

snapshots.label: Fed cuts rates by 50 basis points
snapshots.context: The Federal Reserve announces a half-percentage-point rate cut.

snapshots.label: US election: Trump returns
snapshots.context: US presidential election day. Donald Trump wins; results extend into November 6 UTC.

snapshots.label: Post-election rally
snapshots.context: A Bitcoin market checkpoint following the November 5 US election.

snapshots.label: Bitcoin crosses $100,000
snapshots.context: The first $100,000 trading milestone falls on December 5 UTC, December 4 in US time zones.

snapshots.label: Google unveils Willow quantum chip
snapshots.context: Google announces Willow and quantum error-correction progress. This is not a demonstration of cracking Bitcoin keys.

snapshots.label: After the December Fed decision
snapshots.context: The day after the Federal Reserve’s December 18 policy announcement.

snapshots.label: Trump’s second inauguration
snapshots.context: Donald Trump is inaugurated for his second presidential term.

snapshots.label: DeepSeek market shock
snapshots.context: Technology stocks sell off amid attention to DeepSeek’s AI models.

snapshots.label: US tariff tensions
snapshots.context: A checkpoint following the February 1 US tariff announcements concerning Canada, Mexico and China.

snapshots.label: White House Crypto Summit
snapshots.context: The White House hosts its digital-asset summit.

snapshots.label: US reciprocal tariff announcement
snapshots.context: The US announces its reciprocal-tariff policy; many measures take effect later.

snapshots.label: Tariff turmoil
snapshots.context: A market checkpoint after the April 2 US tariff announcement.

snapshots.label: Pizza Day’s 15th anniversary
snapshots.context: Fifteen years since the reported Bitcoin pizza purchase.

snapshots.label: Israel strikes Iran
snapshots.context: Israel launches strikes against targets in Iran.

snapshots.label: US strikes Iranian nuclear sites
snapshots.context: US strikes hit Iranian nuclear sites. The US announcement is dated June 21 locally; the strikes fall on June 22 UTC.

snapshots.label: October 2025 market correction
snapshots.context: A Bitcoin market checkpoint during the October correction.

snapshots.label: Bitcoin’s 17th anniversary
snapshots.context: Seventeenth anniversary of the genesis block.

snapshots.label: January 2026 rally
snapshots.context: A January rally checkpoint in the Bitcoin daily reference-price series.

snapshots.label: US–Israeli strikes on Iran
snapshots.context: The US president announces military operations against Iran.

snapshots.label: SEC crypto-asset interpretation
snapshots.context: The SEC issues an interpretation of federal securities laws for crypto assets and related transactions.

snapshots.label: Hormuz crypto-toll reports
snapshots.context: Reports describe proposed cryptocurrency tolls.

snapshots.label: 2026 observation-window fee peak
snapshots.context: The largest CoinMetrics daily fee total in the April 10–October 19, 2026 selection window. The fee ring uses header-day block totals.

snapshots.label: 2026 observation-window activity peak
snapshots.context: The largest CoinMetrics daily transaction count and hashrate estimate in the April 10–October 19, 2026 selection window.

snapshots.label: Latest complete comparison day
snapshots.context: A present-day reference at this release’s cutoff, rather than a claim that this was a major historical event.

selection.name: Bitcoin and world history: 150 dates
selection.method: Curated historical events and market or network turning points, with one latest-day comparison. Selection is editorial, not an objective ranking; dates cannot establish causation.
